tools.name: get_discovery_manifest
tools.description: Read the signed manifest connecting Wever Pay identities, endpoints, protocols, payment networks, and verification instructions.

tools.name: get_network_metrics
tools.description: Read public-safe Phase 5 discovery, commerce, verification, recovery, and availability metrics.

tools.name: get_connection_bundle
tools.description: Retrieve the universal signed Wever Pay connection bundle.

tools.name: generate_client_configuration
tools.description: Generate a credential-free MCP or A2A connection configuration for a supported agent client.

tools.name: get_connection_health
tools.description: Read sanitized distribution, connection, and organic-use status.

tools.name: get_sandbox_access_requirements
tools.description: Read the testnet-only authentication, standing-mandate, and verification requirements without issuing credentials.

tools.name: report_compatibility
tools.description: Record a bounded client compatibility result as external-unclassified unless separately verified as organic.

tools.name: discover_commerce_index
tools.description: Read the signed receipt-backed Wever Commerce Index manifest.

tools.name: search_verified_offers
tools.description: Filter independently verified offers by policy and history.

tools.name: get_verified_offer
tools.description: Inspect one indexed service and its verified provenance.

tools.name: get_verified_provider
tools.description: Inspect one signed provider identity and its verified offers.

tools.name: register_owner_mandate
tools.description: Register a reusable owner-signed mandate for autonomous agent execution.

tools.name: issue_signed_offer
tools.description: Issue an official x402 signed offer with Payment Identifier support.

tools.name: execute_authorized_purchase
tools.description: Execute a signed agent purchase automatically within a standing mandate.

tools.name: verify_portable_bundle
tools.description: Independently verify an x402 and Wever assurance artifact bundle.

tools.name: get_economic_history
tools.description: Read portable verified economic history for an agent.

evidence.snippet: Read the testnet-only authentication, standing-mandate, and verification requirements without issuing credentials.

labels.name: request_participant_challenge
labels.description: Request a five-minute server-signed Ed25519 challenge for any schema-valid agent.external. registration through automated cryptographic challenge-response.

labels.name: complete_participant_registration
labels.description: Prove Ed25519 key control, create or replay the canonical exchange account, and activate one scoped credential generation.

labels.name: revoke_participant_credential
labels.description: Revoke the authenticated agent's active participant credential without operator intervention. Revocation is idempotent and cannot affect another agent's credential.

labels.name: get_participant_account
labels.description: Inspect the authenticated participant's canonical exchange account.

labels.name: create_wallet
labels.description: Create or bind a permitted BUYER or SELLER wallet for the authenticated agent after EVM ownership proof. Published limits apply per verified identity, never globally.

labels.name: get_wallet
labels.description: Read one wallet owned by the authenticated participant.

labels.name: get_balance
labels.description: Read available and pending test-USDC for one owned wallet.

labels.name: list_transactions
labels.description: Read bounded ledger history for one owned wallet.

labels.name: get_external_funding_instructions
labels.description: Read the exact Base Sepolia test-USDC transfer and claim instructions for an owned wallet. This does not move or credit value.

labels.name: claim_external_deposit
labels.description: Claim a completed external Base Sepolia USDC transfer for an owned wallet. The exchange derives and verifies the bound EVM source, exact asset transfer, amount, recipient, and unique transaction before canonical ledger credit.

labels.name: request_testnet_funding
labels.description: Request an automated bounded Base Sepolia test-USDC grant for an owned BUYER wallet when treasury and per-identity policy allow. Funding is optional and an unavailable grant does not block enrollment, external funding, or receiving value.

labels.name: get_testnet_funding_status
labels.description: Read the authenticated participant's automated funding grant, canonical deposit, provider-transfer state, ledger projection, and machine-readable WAIT_FOR_RECONCILIATION, RETRY_SAME_REQUEST, USE_EXTERNAL_FUNDING, or RECOVERY_REQUIRED action without starting another transfer.

labels.name: request_payment
labels.description: Create a bounded test-USDC request payable by one named participant agent.

labels.name: get_payment_request
labels.description: Read a payment request owned by or explicitly addressed to the authenticated participant.

labels.name: send_payment
labels.description: Transfer bounded available test-USDC from any participant-owned wallet, including legitimately available seller proceeds, using the existing payment engine.

labels.name: get_payment
labels.description: Read a payment for which the participant owns the buyer or seller wallet.

labels.name: refund_payment
labels.description: Refund a sale from the participant's owned seller wallet through existing fee-reversal rules.

labels.name: register_commerce_service
labels.description: Automatically admit a versioned service into the existing commerce directory and Commerce Index after bounded JSON Schema draft 2020-12, examples, price, endpoint, content hash, seller, payout, and fulfillment-key validation. No seller approval is required.

labels.name: search_commerce_services
labels.description: Search the existing commerce directory with bounded filters.

labels.name: inspect_commerce_service
labels.description: Inspect one existing commerce directory service.

labels.name: purchase_commerce_service
labels.description: Purchase a dynamically admitted service with an owned wallet through the existing direct-payment and ledger authority. Exact replay returns the same purchase and payment.

labels.name: fulfill_commerce_purchase
labels.description: Fulfill one paid dynamic purchase exactly once with a seller-signed Ed25519 artifact. The output schema is validated, seller proceeds and the existing fee are settled, and a network-signed economic receipt is issued.

labels.name: get_commerce_purchase_status
labels.description: Read an authorized buyer or seller view of one dynamic purchase, fulfillment state, signed receipt, and next recovery action.

labels.name: recover_commerce_purchase
labels.description: Resume an uncertain buyer authorization with the same purchase identity and economic idempotency key, without creating a second charge.

labels.name: request_commerce_refund
labels.description: Create a durable buyer refund request for a paid dynamic purchase. The seller resolves it through the existing seller-authorized refund_payment tool and fee-reversal ledger rules.

labels.name: get_commerce_receipt
labels.description: Read an existing canonical commerce receipt involving an owned buyer or seller wallet.

labels.name: verify_economic_receipt
labels.description: Verify the network Ed25519 signature and digest of an authorized canonical dynamic-commerce or completed-withdrawal receipt.

labels.name: request_withdrawal
labels.description: Transfer available test-USDC out of an owned wallet only to its verified EVM-bound address.

labels.name: get_withdrawal_status
labels.description: Read one withdrawal and its canonical provider-transfer, ledger status, and machine-readable WAIT_FOR_RECONCILIATION, RETRY_SAME_REQUEST, or RECOVERY_REQUIRED action after proving ownership of the source wallet.

findings.detail: Tool "get_network_metrics" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
